description: This is a PHP unit test class for the ApplicantController within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It tests the functionality of handling applicant application submissions, including validation, data persistence, and response handling.

classes.name: ApplicantControllerTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the ApplicantController's handling of recruitment applicant submissions, including validation, database inserts, and response redirects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by truncating specific tables and populating fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testHandle
methods.description: Main test method that simulates applicant form submissions, validates responses, and checks database state after submission.

methods.name: dataProviderForController
methods.description: Provides various test cases with different applicant data and expected outcomes for the handle method.
